title: Trost Richards at PAFA
content: The exhibition "A Mine of Beauty: Landscapes of William Trost Richards" opens today at thePennsylvania Academy of the Arts in Pennsylvania.(PAFA) in Philadelphia.I had a chance to preview the exhibition, and it's a wonderful collection of the 19th century master's miniature watercolor landscapes, plus a few of his large oils.Catalog:A Mine of Beauty: Landscapes by William Trost Richards
